focus_areas: Internal anatomical correctness of feet within socks (toes, heel, ankle)
3D spatial grounding and depth consistency between foreground and background
Texture consistency of the knit pattern across curved surfaces
Boundary sharpness between the pink toe cap and blue sock body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the pink toe and the blue fabric. AI models often struggle with color transitions on curved textiles, leading to smearing. Also, verify that the knit pattern distorts logically around the heel and ankle bones; inconsistent pattern warping is a strong indicator of generation artifacts. Crucially, use the pose auditor to ensure the feet inside have valid human anatomy (distinct toes, correct heel curve) and use the depth auditor to ensure the background doesn't melt into the feet.
